documentationDesc: Funda indlela yokusebenzisa i-Novera kwaye ujonge iimpawu zayo.
releaseNotesDesc: Bona into entsha kuguqulelo lwamva nje lwe-Novera.
discussionsDesc: Joyina uluntu lwethu ukuze ufumane inkxaso kunye neengxoxo.
reportAnIssueDesc: Ufumene ibug? Sincede ngokufaka umba kwi-GitHub.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Indawo yemiyalezo, imifuziselo ekhutshelweyo kunye nenye idatha.

others.spellCheckDesc: Nika amandla ukujonga ukupela kwimisonto yakho.
others.resetFactoryDesc: Buyisela isicelo kwisimo saso sokuqala, ukucima zonke iimodeli kunye nembali yencoko. Esi senzo asinakuguqulwa kwaye siyacetyiswa kuphela ukuba isicelo sonakalisiwe.

interface.title: Ujongano
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Apho izaziso ze-toast zivela khona. Kwi-Windows, ukungagqibeki kusezantsi-ekunene ukuze ii-popups zingagubungeli izilawuli zefestile.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Bonisa iithokheni/umzuzwana kunye nokubala kwethokheni emgqeni ongezantsi kwemiyalezo yomncedisi. Xa icinyiwe, i icon ehlangeneyo ibonisa iinkcukacha ngokucofa.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Sebenzisa umbala we-accent njengemvelaphi yemiyalezo yakho. Xa becinyiwe, batshatisa imiyalezo yomncedisi kunye nesicatshulwa esingenanto kwimvelaphi engathathi hlangothi.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Yongeza ithebhu yokujonga kwangaphambili kwi-HTML kunye neebhloko zekhowudi ze-SVG. HTML iqhuba iphepha elenziwe umfuziselo kwisakhelo sebhokisi yesanti eyenza iiscripts zayo kodwa ayikwazi ukufikelela Novera, iifayile zakho, okanye inethiwekhi; I-SVG inikezela ngokwamanani ngezikripthi zivaliwe. Icinywe ngokungagqibekanga.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Zishwankathele iincoko ezintsha zibe ngumsonto wesihloko. Cima ukugcina isihloko esihlala sihleli ude usinike elinye igama ngokwakho.
interface.accentDesc: Khetha umbala we-accent osetyenziswe kuyo yonke i-UI.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Seta kwakhona zonke iisetingi zojongano ngokwendalo.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Zonke iisetingi zojongano zibuyiselwe kwimeko yesiqhelo.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Khetha ukuba indawo yokujonga incoko kufuneka isabele njani xa imiyalezo emitsha ifika.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Igcina indawo yokujonga ibambelele kumyalezo wamva nje owuthumelayo.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Ilandela ngokuzenzekelayo njengoko iimpendulo zihamba ngexesha lokwenyani.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Bonisa into yokubala yophawu ngaphakathi kwigalelo lengxoxo. Xa ivaliwe, ikhawuntara yethokheni ibonakala ngezantsi kwegalelo.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Seta kwakhona isimbo sekhowudi yebhlokhi ngokwendalo.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Ukusetwa kwakhona kwesimbo sekhowudi yebhloko ngempumelelo
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Isimbo sebhloko sekhowudi sibuyiselwe kwimeko yesiqhelo.
interface.subtitle: Yenza Novera eyakho, ukusuka kwinkangeleko yayo ukuya kukhetho lwakho lwencoko.
interface.accentColorDesc: Khetha isinyanzeliso kunye nombala webar esecaleni.

hardware.name: Igama
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Sebenzisa i-Vulkan API ye-GPU yokukhawulezisa. Musa ukuyenza iVulkan ukuba unayo i-NVIDIA GPU njengoko inokubangela imiba yokuhambelana.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Akukho GPU zibonakalayo kwi-injini ye-llama.cpp. Iimodeli ziya kusebenza kwi-CPU.
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: I-GPU yabelana ngephuli enye yememori kunye ne-CPU - iimodeli zitsalwa kwimemori efanayo kunye nenkqubo yonke.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: IiGPU zakho zitshintshile, ke injini yasekhaya yaphinda yaqalwa. Iimodeli ziphinda zilayishwe kusetyenziso olulandelayo.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: IiGPU zakho zitshintshile, kodwa imodeli ixakekile. Yiyeke, emva koko ucinezele uHlaziya ukusebenzisa i-GPU entsha.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: I-URL kunye nezibuko lomncedisi wakho ongomnye.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Uluhlu olwahlulwe ngekoma lweenginginya zokugqitha ummeleli.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Vumela izatifikethi ozisayinayo okanye ezingangqinisiswanga. Oku kunokufuneka kwezinye iiproxi kodwa kunciphisa ukhuseleko. Yenza kuphela ukuba uyamthemba ummeli wakho.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Qinisekisa isatifikethi se-SSL xa uqhagamshela kwi-proxy.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Qinisekisa i-SSL izatifikethi zeendawo ekuyiwa kuzo.

webSearch.title: Uphendlo lwewebhu
webSearch.description: Vumela iimodeli zikhangele kwaye zifunde iwebhu usebenzisa izixhobo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi ze-Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Yazisa izixhobo ze-web_search kunye ne-web_fetch kwiimodeli ezixhasa ukusetyenziswa kwesixhobo. Isebenza ngaphandle kwebhokisi ngaphandle kweqhosha le-API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Khetha i-backend ephendula i-web_search kunye ne-web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Ngokuzikhethela. Nikeza isitshixo se-{{provider}} API kwimida yezinga eliphezulu kunye neziphumo ezicwangcisiweyo. Shiya ingenanto ukuze usebenzise isiphelo esingenazitshixo sasimahla.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Ifunekayo. I-{{provider}} idinga isitshixo se-API ukubuyisela iziphumo.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Ifunekayo. Isiseko se-URL somzekelo wakho we-{{provider}}, kunye ne-JSON API inikwe amandla.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Qwalasela indawo ye-arhente ye-Cowork: iqokobhe layo elinebhokisi yesanti, kunye neenkumbulo kunye nezakhono ezigcinwe ngokusisigxina kwifolda yakho yedatha ye-Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Imiyalelo eqhutywa yi-{{backend}}: banokubhala kuphela ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yeseshoni, kwaye iifayile ezikwifolda yakho yasekhaya azifundeki.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Akukho bhokisi yesanti ekhoyo kule nkqubo, ngoko ke isixhobo seqokobhe asinikezelwanga. Imiyalelo ayikhe iqhutywe ingathintelwanga.
cowork.networkDesc: Vumela imiyalelo ye-Cowork ifikelele kwinethiwekhi, kwizinto ezifana nokufaka iipakethi okanye ukulanda indawo yokugcina. Ivuliwe ngokungagqibekanga. Iqokobhe lengxoxo eliphambili alinakufikelela kwinethiwekhi.
cowork.noMemories: Akukho zinkumbulo okwangoku. Iimodeli zongeza kunye nesixhobo se-memory_write njengoko befunda izinto ezifanele ukugcinwa.
cowork.noSkills: Akukho zakhono okwangoku. Isakhono yiseti yemiyalelo enokusetyenziswa kwakhona imodeli enokuyilayisha ngokwemfuno.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Isihloko esinye kwinqaku ngalinye. Iimodeli zifunde ezi ngasemva ngesixhobo se-memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown imiyalelo, ngokuzithandela kunye nenkcazo kwi-YAML frontmatter. Inkcazo yinto ebonwa yimodeli ngaphambi kokulayisha isakhono.

localApiServer.title: Iseva ye-API yasekuhlaleni
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Jonga iilog ezineenkcukacha zomncedisi we-API wendawo.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Qala ngokuzenzekela iSeva ye-API yaseKhaya xa isicelo siqaliswa.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Gcina umncedisi eqhuba kwitreyi yesistim xa ifestile ivaliwe. Xa icinyiwe, ukuvala ifestile kuyeka i-Novera kwaye kumisa umncedisi.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Iinginginya zivunyelwe ukufikelela kwiseva, zahlulwe ziikoma.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Nika amandla iilog zeseva ezineenkcukacha zolungiso lweempazamo.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Ixesha lokulinda impendulo evela kwimodeli yendawo, imizuzwana.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Imodeli yasekhaya ukulayisha ngokuzenzekelayo xa umncedisi eqala.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Ukusinceda siphucule i-Novera, ungabelana ngedatha engaziwa njengokusetyenziswa kweempawu kunye nokubalwa kwabasebenzisi. Asikhe siqokelele iincoko zakho okanye iinkcukacha zakho.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Unolawulo olupheleleyo kwidatha yakho. Funda ngakumbi kuMgaqo-nkqubo wethu waBucala.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Ukuphucula i-Novera, kufuneka siqonde indlela esetyenziswa ngayo-kodwa kuphela ngoncedo lwakho. Ungalutshintsha olu seto nanini na.
privacy.privacyPromises: Ukhetho lwakho apha aluzukutshintsha izithembiso zethu zabucala ezingundoqo:
privacy.promise1: Iincoko zakho zihlala ziyimfihlo nakwisixhobo sakho
privacy.promise2: Asize siqokelele iinkcukacha zakho zobuqu okanye umxholo wencoko
privacy.promise3: Lonke ulwabelwano ngedatha ayaziwa kwaye ludityanisiwe
privacy.promise4: Ungaphuma nangaliphi na ixesha ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ngumsebenzi
privacy.promise5: Siyibeka elubala malunga nento esiyiqokelelayo nokuba kutheni

attachments.subtitle: Qwalasela izinamathiselo zamaxwebhu, imida yobungakanani, kunye nokuziphatha kokubuyisela.
attachments.enableDesc: Vumela ukufakwa kunye nokufakwa kwezalathisi amaxwebhu ukuba athathwe.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Khetha indlela amaxwebhu acazululiweyo ongezwa ngayo kwiincoko.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Iqhezu lomxholo wemodeli esetyenziswa njengokunqunyulwa kwe-inlining yeefayile ezicazululiweyo kwiimodeli zasekhaya.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Layita Yenza iziqhoboshelo zisebenze ukutshintsha umda wobungakanani boxwebhu.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Obona bukhulu besayizi kuxwebhu ngalunye. Inyanzeliswe ngexesha lokulayisha kunye nokusetyenzwa. Imifanekiso inomda wayo ongentla.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Obona bukhulu besayizi ngomfanekiso (JPEG okanye PNG). Umboneleli wakho okanye imodeli inokunyanzelisa umda ophantsi.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Amanqaku asezantsi afanayo (0-1). Isetyenziselwa kuphela ukukhangela i-cosine yomgca, hayi i-ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Khetha phakathi kwe-sqlite-vec ANN, i-cosine yomgca, okanye i-auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Uqikelelo lobuninzi boonobumba kwisiqwenga ngasinye sokuzinzisa.

changeDataFolder.description: Ngaba uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukutshintsha indawo ekuyo ifolda yedatha? Oku kuya kuhambisa yonke idatha yakho kwindawo entsha kwaye uqale usetyenziso kwakhona.
